title: Lit2Vec Record
description: A single normalized publication record from the Lit2Vec dataset, including metadata, chunked full text, embeddings, and license flags.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for this record, e.g., hash of DOI or OpenAlex ID.

abstract.description: Normalized abstract; may be null if missing.

source.description: Source of the full text (e.g., openalex, unpaywall, publisher).

license_final.description: Resolved license string used for redistribution decision (e.g., CC-BY-4.0).

license_allows_derivatives.description: Whether this record’s license permits redistribution of derivative works (e.g., transformed text or embeddings).

license_sources.description: Raw license strings as reported by each source.

subfield.description: Predicted chemistry subfield label (e.g., analytical_chemistry, inorganic_chemistry, others).

paragraphs.description: List of normalized text paragraphs from the full text.

paragraph_embeddings.description: List of vector embeddings for each paragraph, same order as 'paragraphs'.

classifier_confidence.description: Confidence score from the subfield classifier.

embedding_model.description: Hugging Face model ID used for embedding (e.g., intfloat/e5-base-v2).

embedding_version.description: Hash of model version or commit.
